QuestInfo.name: Ugh, 10 Boogies!
QuestInfo.1: You went to 10 Boogies for information, but it looks like she's the one who needs help. First, go all the way to #bPerion Southern Ridge#k and find the #bJr. Boogie#k monsters.
QuestInfo.2: You found the Informant Badge for 10 Boogies. Will she help you now? Talk to 10 Boogies.

0.0: Except, well... I'm kinda in a bind myself. I mean, it's nothing a knight like myself can't HANDLE, but... \r\n#L0##bWhat is it?#l\n#k
0.1: I lost the badge that shows I'm in league with the knights and I can't find it! I think it might've fallen off when I was taking down the Jr. Boogies around here. Do you think you could find it? I'm gonna be in a lot of hot water if that thing is really gone.

yes.0: Awesome! #bJr. Boogies#k live just south of Perion. It's really close, promise!

no.0: Well, I'm not saying you have to help me but, well... it is how it is...

1.0: Oh my goodness, it's like watching somebody bring my LIFE back! Thank you! Thank you so much!

item.0: #bJr. Boogies#k live south of Perion. It's not really far.
